Progress on vaccinations and strong policy support are lifting activity and employment, and the Fed is maintaining an accommodative stance (0–0.25% policy rate and ongoing Treasury/MBS purchases) while monitoring virus-related risks. The May 2021 Financial Stability Report indicates overall accommodative conditions but highlights elevated asset valuations, strong risk appetite, and vulnerabilities in parts of nonbank finance, even as banks remain resilient. Balancing these positives with noted vulnerabilities, the tone is mildly positive but cautious.
